device.description: 10-bit 1.25 MSPS serial SAR ADC with SPI/DSP interface and auto power-down
device.note: tlv1572.pdf (SLAS171A) p.1 pinout, p.2 terminal functions, p.3 recommended operating conditions, p.5 timing specifications, p.6 Figure 2 uC mode timing, p.10-11 SPI interface (CPOL = 0, CPHA = 1), Figures 8-9 (6 null bits then MSB..LSB), key points

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (ROC), p.5 (timing: 6 SCLK sampling, 10 SCLK conversion, td2 25 ns), p.6 (Figure 2), p.9-10 (DSP mode, key points), p.10-11 (uC interface, Figures 8-9, key points)
notModeled: analog input and VREF: every conversion returns the 0 V code (000h); the conversion is clocked by SCLK (6 SCLKs sampling, 10 SCLKs conversion, result of the current sample output in the same frame)
DSP mode (FS low at CS falling: FS-started frames, DO Hi-Z after the 17th rising edge, back-to-back and variable-length conversions): only uC mode (FS tied high) is modeled; FS is an unused input
CS held low for back-to-back 16-clock frames: modeled as idle repeat of the 16-bit frame; split 8 + 8 clock transfers within 100 us
CS high puts the device into power down (pin name CS/Powerdown) and DO into 3-state; auto power-down after the LSB: no bus-visible effect
tValid (CS falling to DO): no delay given, 0; the first bit appears on the first SCLK rising edge (mode 1); tFloat (CS rising to Hi-Z) not given
tOut = td2 25 ns (output delay after SCLK rising edge in uC mode, p.5); SCLK limits (20 MHz at 5 V, 10 MHz at 3 V)
